options.content:
Data source monitoring
See which systems are sending data and whether their latest data was received successfully.

{{#if (eq user_is_admin 1)}}
{{/if}}

targets.rawSql:
WITH control AS (
  SELECT source_key, data_status, is_paused, review_note
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_source_control
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1
),
last_attempt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_key) source_key, started_at, status, error_message
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1 AND log_type = 'leaf_node'
  ORDER BY source_key, started_at DESC
),
last_success AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_key) source_key, started_at
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1 AND log_type = 'leaf_node' AND status = 'success'
  ORDER BY source_key, started_at DESC
),
source_rows AS (
  SELECT
    c.source_key,
    la.status AS latest_attempt,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM la.started_at) * 1000)::bigint AS last_attempt_ms,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ls.started_at) * 1000)::bigint AS last_received_ms,
    CASE WHEN la.status = 'failed'
         THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(la.error_message, ''), 'Import failed') END AS failure_reason,
    CASE WHEN c.data_status = 'data_loaded' THEN 'data_loaded' ELSE 'no_data' END AS data_status,
    c.is_paused,
    CASE WHEN c.review_note = 'Mapped' THEN 'manual' ELSE 'default' END AS org_unit_mapping
  FROM control c
  LEFT JOIN last_attempt la ON la.source_key = c.source_key
  LEFT JOIN last_success ls ON ls.source_key = c.source_key
),
schedule AS (
  SELECT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM next_run_at) * 1000)::bigint AS next_run_ms
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_schedule_status
  WHERE id = 1 AND $UserIsAdmin = 1
),
last_run AS (
  SELECT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(started_at)) * 1000)::bigint AS last_run_ms
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1 AND log_type = 'leaf_node'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(s) ORDER BY s.source_key) FROM source_rows s), '[]'::json)::text AS rows_json,
  (SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM (SELECT sc.next_run_ms, lr.last_run_ms FROM last_run lr LEFT JOIN schedule sc ON true) t)::text AS schedule_json,
  COALESCE(current_setting('app.is_central_node', true), 'false') AS is_central_node,
  $UserIsAdmin AS user_is_admin
